We have two successful applications: first SMILES gave precursor pair A, third SMILES gave precursor pair B (slightly different first precursor due to Si group location). Need to output list of lists where each inner list contains SMILES of each precursor. So we have two inner lists.

First list: ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C", "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC"]

Second list: ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO", "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC"]

Check formatting: need list of lists, double quotes, proper escaping. Provide as final answer.
